original: Build a reusable calculator for this digital mixture ledger. Batch A contributes 750 mL at 2.4 g/L, batch B 1.6 L at 950 mg/L, and a final water addition contributes 250 mL. Assume additive volumes and no loss. Convert each concentration and volume as needed, calculate final concentration in mg/L, and independently reconcile total solute mass. Give a reusable computational product with scope for future volume/concentration rows. This is a numerical data-reconciliation exercise with no laboratory activity.
scope: Native runtime and Pages bridge with operator-authored actions and no live model inference
